title: The Resultative Sublative in Culinary and Transformation Contexts

sections.title: The Sublative Case (-ra/-re) as Resultative Marker
sections.content: In Hungarian, the sublative case suffix (-ra/-re) frequently functions as a resultative predicate delimiter when attached to adjectives. Instead of merely describing how an action is performed (manner), it denotes the final state, color, or physical condition into which the object is transformed as a direct consequence of the verbal process.

sections.title: Fixed Idiomatic Collocations in Gastronomy
sections.content: Culinary discourse relies heavily on fixed resultative syntagms: puhára főz (to cook tender), aranybarnára süt (to bake golden brown), pirosra pirít (to toast red/crisp), sűrűre beforral (to boil down thick), and omlósra párol (to braise until crumbly/tender). Notice the contrast between manner adverbs (puhán tálalja - serves it while soft) and resultative sublatives (puhára főzi - boils it UNTIL it becomes soft).

sections.title: Resultative Sublative Transformations
rows: A szakács puhára főzte a marhahúst.
The cook boiled the beef until it became tender.
A húst aranybarnára sütötték a kemencében.
The meat was roasted golden brown in the oven.
A mártást sűrűre forralták az ünnepi asztalra.
The sauce was boiled down thick for the festive table.

items.spanish: A szakácsok órákon át párolták a szarvashúst, amíg teljesen puhára nem főtt.
items.english: The cooks braised the venison for hours until it cooked completely tender.

items.spanish: A vadkacsát szép pirosra és ropogósra sütötték a nyárson.
items.english: The wild duck was roasted nice and red and crispy on the spit.

items.spanish: A vörösbort lassú tűzön forralták, hogy a fűszeres mártás sűrűre sűrűsödjön.
items.english: They simmered the red wine on a low heat so that the spiced sauce would thicken up thick.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Always distinguish the resultative sublative (-ra/-re) from adverbs of manner (-an/-en). When the state is the goal or endpoint of cooking, use -ra/-re: 'aranybarnára süt' (bakes until golden brown), not 'aranybarnán süt'.
